name: pg_join_computation_varnullingrels_translating
subject: Fix computation of varnullingrels when translating appendrel Var
area: planner, lateral UNION ALL under outer joins
goal:
Pulling up a lateral UNION ALL below an outer join can lose the fact that an outer relation's columns may have been null-extended. A later `IS NOT NULL` filter is then simplified incorrectly and rows containing NULL leak into the result.

Create a table, left join it to another relation, then use a lateral UNION ALL that references the nullable side and filter the lateral output with `IS NOT NULL`. The query must return only the rows for which the referenced value is actually non-null, with EXPLAIN retaining the necessary semantics. Equivalent non-lateral UNION ALL and inner joins must not change.
